name: Qdrant
summary: Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine written in Rust. It stores vectors with JSON payloads, applies filters during HNSW traversal, and supports dense plus sparse hybrid search and several quantization schemes. It runs self-hosted or in Qdrant Cloud, including hybrid and private cloud options.
facts: Dense and sparse vectors (BM25, SPLADE++, miniCOIL), payload filters
Scalar, binary, asymmetric; 4-bit TurboQuant storage in v1.19
Self-hosted, Qdrant Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, Private Cloud
Free cloud tier (1 GB RAM); usage-based Standard tier
goodFor: Self-hosted vector search with heavy metadata filtering
Moving from self-hosted to managed without changing engines
watchOut: A separate service to run and tune (memory, quantization, sharding)
Premium, hybrid and private cloud prices are not published
Free cloud tier has no high availability
